redCandidate.publicEntry: AIOS plan task CLI plus default orchestration and durable dream archive-index recall
redCandidate.setup: Use isolated workspaces. Start a real plan, declare task metadata through the public CLI, invoke default local dry-run orchestration without --context-task, and rewrite an existing dream proposal at the same path after materializing its archive index.
redCandidate.expected: CLI task declarations persist and deliver non-empty context through default orchestration; the earliest dependency-ready pending task is selected; a same-path proposal rewrite rebuilds the archive index before filtering memo events.
redCandidate.observed: 10/13 tests pass and three behavior tests fail. plan task emits usage rather than declaration JSON, a multi-task plan reports not_applicable instead of observed, and a rewritten proposal remains hidden by the stale archive index.
redCandidate.failureReason: The CLI has no declaration flags or persistence path, default task selection rejects multiple candidates, and the archive source token signs only the proposals directory rather than its file contents.
